idea_name: Smash day close beyond prior extremes then fail-through reversal
mechanism: Smash bar closes below (buy setup) or above (sell) lows/highs of N prior bars, not outside bar; next bar break of smash high/low confirms trapped breakout failure; SL at smash extreme.
data_needed: OHLC bars; lookback N; entry mode cross vs close
why_new_for_mis: Emotional-breakout failure as an explicit reversal/change sensor after false structural breaks.
quote: a smash day is a session in which price appears to break decisively beyond the recent price structure... Smash days question it. Larry Williams observed that many strong-looking breakouts fail quickly.

idea_name: Hidden smash: weak close location in bar range + next-bar confirm
mechanism: Bullish hidden smash: close>prev close but in lower 25% of own range (optional close<open); confirm on next bar close above smash high. Inverse for bearish upper 25%. Optional ATR-based SL.
data_needed: OHLC; range quartile; ATR for SL mode
why_new_for_mis: Internal exhaustion sensor from close location within bar range without needing external structure breaks.
quote: A Hidden Smash Day is defined by the position of the closing price within the bar’s own range, combined with a comparison to the previous session’s close.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: AHC dendrogram clusters of bar-range vectors for volatility regime sizing
mechanism: On each bar, build unsupervised AHC on vectors of recent H-L ranges (AlgLib ClusterizerRunAHC); label clusters by mean next-bar range; size lots by cluster of current point (high/mid/low vol).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 2022-10–2023-10 with AO signal + MoneyAHC
why_new_for_mis: Hierarchical clustering of multi-bar range features as a volatility-regime sensor driving position size.
quote: Paying attention to volatility is arguably significant because of what is often called volatility clustering.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
idea_name: Number-wall LFSR forecast of MA with Toeplitz solvability filter
mechanism: Build number-wall matrix on MA buffer via cross-rule polynomials; Set() yields recurrence coeffs for next value; Solvability=Toeplitz determinant gates trust; SetOutput normalizes forecast to sequence scale for trailing TP/SL.
data_needed: MA (or BB/Envelopes) buffer sequence length m_length
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 with AO signal + TrailingLFSR vs PSAR control
why_new_for_mis: Sequence-convergence / LFSR projection sensor for indicator series used to adapt trailing distances.
quote: If we create a matrix that has all rows related to each other... if the sequence is convergent then the determinant of this matrix will be zero. This is a more compute efficient way for testing for convergence

idea_name: AFML bet sizing from classifier probability and concurrency
mechanism: BetSizeProbability/Dynamic/Budget/Reserve map p(side), forecast-price divergence, occupancy imbalance, and MoG CDF of concurrent longs-shorts into signed size∈[-1,1]; NormCDF and EF3M in pure MQL5.
data_needed: classifier probs/sides; open/close bet times; optional price forecast
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: classifier-driven EAs from earlier blueprint parts; bar-driven loop
why_new_for_mis: Confidence-and-concurrency sensing layer converting ML signal quality into exposure—useful MIS meta-sensor for sizing.
quote: probability-based sizing propagates classifier confidence into position magnitude and corrects for label concurrency

idea_name: FQF state-conditioned quantile distribution for reward
mechanism: Fully Parameterized Quantile Function learns Softmax-normalized cumulative quantiles per state-action instead of fixed uniform quantiles; approximates full return distribution for distributed RL.
data_needed: state embeddings; reward samples; ~32 quantiles recommended
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: trading RL setup from NN-made-easy series
why_new_for_mis: Distributional return sensor that adapts quantile spacing to market state rather than assuming uniform bins.
quote: instead of a random quantile generator, it uses a fully connected neural layer, which returns the distribution of quantiles based on the current state of the environment

idea_name: Ensemble dynamics disagreement as exploration / uncertainty bonus
mechanism: Train ensemble of forward models; intrinsic interest = variance of next-state (or hidden) predictions across models; add disagreement to action selection to explore uncertain regions; converges in stochastic areas unlike pure prediction-error curiosity.
data_needed: experience replay of (s,a,s'); ensemble of dynamics nets
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: RL trading agent in series environment
why_new_for_mis: Model-disagreement uncertainty sensor for regime novelty / exploration useful as MIS confidence or rarity flag.
quote: the intrinsic reward R*i* is defined as the variance in the output of different models in the ensemble.

idea_name: Go-Explore archive of revisited promising states
mechanism: Phase-1 multi-agent random exploration archives states and action paths; return-to-archive then continue exploring; phase-2 policy learning on archive—tackles sparse rewards by remembering promising market states.
data_needed: state descriptors; action path buffers; multi-thread tester agents
why_new_for_mis: Explicit memory of rare/promising market states as an exploration sensor for hard reward landscapes.
quote: The main idea of Go-Explore is to remember and return to promising states. This is fundamental for effective operation when the number of rewards is limited.

idea_name: Scaling Go-Explore for longer nonstationary history
mechanism: Discusses curse of dimensionality, environment change, and action-selection upgrades when extending Go-Explore beyond ~1 month; suggests PCA, evolutionary search, confidence-based exploration, and monitoring structural breaks.
data_needed: longer historical windows; possible PCA of states
why_new_for_mis: Operational sensing of when exploration archives break under nonstationarity—meta for long-horizon MIS.
quote: As the training period increases, changes in the environment may occur that may affect the agent's learning outcomes.

idea_name: Hierarchical SAC-X multi-intent policies with scheduler
mechanism: High-level scheduler selects among intents (policies) each maximizing an auxiliary/external reward component; shares off-policy experience across intents for sparse trading rewards at entry/exit vs risk levels.
data_needed: vector of external+auxiliary rewards; per-intent policies
why_new_for_mis: Multi-timescale decision sensing: macro intent selection over micro action policies.
quote: High-level strategies can analyze macroeconomic factors at a higher level... while at the same time considering microeconomic factors at a lower level
